svg.title: AkiDB system block diagram
svg.desc: Callers reach one akidb server. The server authenticates, plans retrieval across CPU HNSW, BM25, optional SQL, and bounded graph expansion, then returns ContextPackV1. RocksDB and an HNSW snapshot hold local state.
